description: Truck routes of cube-hunt's RoadMap with main.ts geometry. For each target: costs = routeFrom cost from each ramp lane (TUNNEL.x + RAMP_LANES[k], ring.y1); lane = the one sendTruck picks; route = that lane's path as x0, y0, x1, y1, ... (the lane entry first, the parking point last). Board state: eaten cells in order, then claimed cells. docs/ROADS.md.
